profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience in several industries. Have worked with a wide variety of platforms, languages and technologies. Ruby on Rails, Java, RDBMS and Hadoop experience. Have  developed for several relational and non-relational DBMS. Have worked as an Oracle database administrator. Passionate about developing software and always looking for ways to up my game.

Specialties: Ruby on Rails, Java, SQL, NoSQL, Cassandra, Hadoop, Databases, Android, RDBMS (Oracle, MySQL, etc.), Database Administration, Algorithms, MVC frameworks, REST, DevOPS
